messages:
michael: Quick sync — I'm running an apples-to-apples compare between replay and synthetic for eval V2. Need to lock down kernel selection and KV cache priming rules.

anya: Can you paste the command + config? also include tokenizer alignment details

michael: here's the run config:

```json
{"model":"gptx-7b","decode":{"temp":0.0,"top_p":0.95,"stop":["\n\n"]},"kernel_policy":"auto:prefer_fast","batching":{"max_tokens":1024,"max_batch_size":64,"timeout_ms":10},"kv_warmup":"prefetch_first_5_prefixes"}
```

sam: Make sure tokenizer is identical between replay/synth: use `--tokenizer-version v3` and `--no-skip-unk`.

jord: started the replay harness with that config, tag `replay-eq-172345` — will report perf.

ci-bot: load test finished (replay-eq-172345): p50=46ms p95=228ms p99=430ms errors=0

michael: saw p95 +18ms vs baseline. runtime logs show kernel fallback in ~6% of batches:

```
[2026-01-24T12:34:56Z] kernel_select: chosen=generic_float16 reason=latency_estimate_mismatch
[2026-01-24T12:34:56Z] kernel_select: chosen=fast_int8 reason=best_match
```

anya: KV miss rate increased to 12% during early prefixes — could be replay ordering mismatches.

sam: this often happens if stop sequences/tokenizer boundaries differ. Even one extra byte in a prefix can change tokenization and subsequent KV hits.

michael: re-ran with strict tokenizer pin + identical decode params and forced `kernel_policy=prefer_fast`. Results: p95=210ms (within baseline). Will add two follow-ups:
1) enforce tokenizer v3 in harness and recording
2) force kernel selection in the apples config
3) add explicit prefix priming step to replay harness (prewarm first 5 prefixes)

lisa: Can we also add a synthetic spike run that forces batch-size boundary transitions? e.g., keys that push 63->65 items to trigger different batching kernel.

sam: good call. I'll add `seq_spike` scenario to `perf/bench/configs/eq_load_v2.json` and capture runtime traces (cpu/gpu + decision logs). Also capturing `kv_cache.hit_rate` and per-batch kernel_choice.

perf-bot: heads-up: config flag `runtime.prefer_fast` will be toggled in next canary, watch for regressions :eyes:

anya: thanks — assigning follow-ups: @sam (add spike + traces), @michael (update harness), @lisa (monitor canary once flipped) :+1:
